bracket: [Textbook answer-key error: the printed key gives "SSC Test", which names no test this chapter teaches. The four congruence tests introduced here are side-side-side, side-angle-side, angle-side-angle and hypotenuse-side, and the intended answer is plainly the first of them: the figure marks all THREE pairs of corresponding sides congruent (one tick on AB and PQ, two on BC and QR, three on AC and PR) and marks no angle anywhere, so side-side-side is the only test that applies. It is a one-letter misprint, the final S set as a C. Confirmed off the printed answer page at 3x magnification, where the third glyph is an open C, clearly distinct from the two closed-loop S's before it and from the "SAS Test" printed immediately to its right. The remaining three parts of this same key entry are correct.]

[Textbook misprint: the printed question states the betweenness as "C - E - D", which contradicts both figure 3.63 and the result the question itself asks to be proved. Figure 3.63 draws D between C and E -- the right-angle mark and the dashed seg AD sit ABOVE E on seg CB -- so the order along seg CB is C, D, E, B. That order is what yields \(\angle DAE = \frac{1}{2}(\angle C - \angle B)\), the stated result. The printed order C - E - D yields \(\angle DAE = \frac{1}{2}(\angle B - \angle C)\) instead, and it can only occur when \(\angle B > \angle C\), which would make the expression the question asks for negative. Verified numerically on four triangles: with \(\angle B = 44^\circ, \angle C = 58^\circ\), with \(\angle B = 30^\circ, \angle C = 95^\circ\) and with \(\angle B = 70^\circ, \angle C = 71^\circ\) the foot of the altitude falls between C and the foot of the bisector (order C - D - E) and \(\angle DAE\) equals \(\frac{1}{2}(\angle C - \angle B)\) exactly; only with \(\angle B = 80^\circ, \angle C = 40^\circ\) does the order become C - E - D, and there \(\angle DAE\) equals \(\frac{1}{2}(\angle B - \angle C)\). The question is solved as the figure and the printed result require. The stem is transcribed exactly as printed.]
